scope: Calibrate existing POLYLINE staging node and bucket-pointer-array estimates against allocator-requested bytes for production-shaped STL containers, without changing production behavior or claiming an RSS bound.

method.kind: Focused generated in-memory test with a rebind-aware accounting allocator
platformsQualified: Local GCC build and active standard-library implementation only

trackedShapes: std::map<Handle, std::set<Handle>> claim index with the production key/value shapes
pending owner unordered_map with the exact PendingPolylineState mapped value
orphan owner unordered_map with the exact OrphanPolylineVertexState mapped value
implementation.observed: Rebind-aware test allocator records live, peak, and call counts for requested allocate(n) bytes across each container's allocator rebinds.
assertions: The existing conservative claim-map/set node estimates cover the active STL's measured peak requested bytes for the generated population.
The existing pending/orphan node plus full current bucket-pointer-array estimate covers measured peak requested bytes when insertion does not rehash.
Clear releases tracked tree nodes and owner-map nodes while retaining no more than the modeled bucket requests; container destruction releases all tracked requests.
notMeasured: allocator metadata and per-allocation hidden overhead
implementation-specific transient allocations outside observed allocate(n) calls
process RSS or a whole-reader memory bound
other standard-library implementations or platform qualification
